commit_message:
Fix argmax split reduction matching and tests

Address review comments:

- Replace the optional assert and dereference in splitArgmaxReduction with a match failure.

- Use the matched maximumf neutral element for canonical argmax identity, and only synthesize -inf for StableHLO select-style argmax.

- Replace std::pair uses with named structs for argmax combiner results and StableHLO value condition matches.

- Remove getArgmaxKind from the public LinalgExt utils API and inline isArgmaxOp through getArgmaxCombinerInfo.

- Rename stripFloatCast to stripFloatExtTrunc to describe the operations it strips.

- Add positive tests for mixed bf16-to-f32 select-style argmax and swapped OrI/AndI conditions.

- Fix the ROCM argmax ukernel test to use the reduction dimension index in the 4D case.

Signed-off-by: Yuwei Sun <yuweis2@illinois.edu>

Signed-off-by: Hao Ren <rhao8608@gmail.com>

Co-authored-by: Hao Ren <rhao8608@gmail.com>
name: pre-commit

commit_message:
Fix argmax split reduction matching and tests

Address review comments:

- Replace the optional assert and dereference in splitArgmaxReduction with a match failure.

- Use the matched maximumf neutral element for canonical argmax identity, and only synthesize -inf for StableHLO select-style argmax.

- Replace std::pair uses with named structs for argmax combiner results and StableHLO value condition matches.

- Remove getArgmaxKind from the public LinalgExt utils API and inline isArgmaxOp through getArgmaxCombinerInfo.

- Rename stripFloatCast to stripFloatExtTrunc to describe the operations it strips.

- Add positive tests for mixed bf16-to-f32 select-style argmax and swapped OrI/AndI conditions.

- Fix the ROCM argmax ukernel test to use the reduction dimension index in the 4D case.
